text:
Alex: FYI I'm getting multiple SLO alerts for 'ingest:log-errors' in eu-west1 since 04:05 UTC, looks correlated with GPU pool churn.
Priya: saw that, digging. Are these actual errors or just increased debug spam? :mag:
Alex: pretty noisy, lots of lines like `gpu-provision: node reaped, reason=preemptible`. Tail shows stack of JSON fields, maybe our stdout->loki pipeline is exploding and creating parse errors.
Maria: can you paste a sample? I want to check if correlation_id is being preserved.
Alex: here's a sanitized snippet:
```
time=2026-03-09T04:06:12Z level=info component=gpu-provision msg=\"node_reaped\" node=gpu-eu-12 reason=preemptible correlation_id=97a1b2c3d4e5f6g7 trace=9f8e7d6c
```
Jordan: correlation_id looks truncated — we normally use 32 hex for trace_id. The `correlation_id` here is 16 chars. Might be our nginx ingress header size or a logger format change.
Sam (oncall): Alerts are flapping in grafana: `Ingest Errors > 50 / 5m` -> fires, then resolves.
Priya: I'm checking Loki ingestion errors metric: `loki_ingester_failed_push_requests_total` spiked at same time. Could be a pipeline parse error causing retries and backpressure.
Maria: Suggest we update the Loki query used by the SLO alert. Current alert uses a broad `{env=\"prod\"} |= \"error\"` which catches a lot of unrelated messages. We should narrow to `{app=\"ingest\"} |= \"ERROR\"` and add `| json` to ensure valid JSON entries only.
Alex: current SLO alert rule snippet:
```
ALERT IngestLogErrors
  IF sum(increase(loki_ingestor_push_errors_total[5m])) by(cluster) > 20
  FOR 2m
```
Priya: proposed change:
```
ALERT IngestLogErrorsCluster
  IF sum(increase(loki_ingestor_push_errors_total{cluster=~\"eu-.*\"}[10m])) by(cluster) > 50
  FOR 10m
```
This groups by cluster and extends the evaluation window to cut noise.
Jordan: also add a label `severity=\"page\"` only when `sum` > 200 and `severity=\"ticket\"` for 50-199.
Sam (oncall): +1. Also can we add a guard in the Loki promtail pipeline to drop lines that are > 1MB or that fail JSON parse? Those are causing index churn.
Priya: yes, I'll push a temporary relabel to drop `level=debug` and `msg=probe` from gpu-provision logs in eu-west1 for 30m while we debug.
log-bot: deploy-bot started rolling relabel config to promtail-eu-west1 (canary 3 nodes) :gear:
Alex: thanks. One more thing — Kibana trace join failing because traceid mismatch (short correlation_id). We should verify the forwarder keeps `traceparent` header. If truncation is at the edge, add x-request-id fallback.
Maria: I'll open a quick PR to our logging agent to preserve `traceparent` and to propagate `x-request-id` into the JSON `trace_id` field.
Priya: Owner list: Priya (temporary relabel, 15m), Maria (logging-agent PR), Jordan (alert rule changes), Sam (monitoring watch). I'll roll the changes in a canary and update here when done.
Sam (oncall): I'm on-call for the next 2 hours, will ack pages and mute noisy alerts if they keep firing.
Alex: great — if anyone sees >10% error rate after changes ping here. :eyes:
Jordan: noted, I'll also add a heatmap panel to Grafana for `loki_ingestor_push_errors_total` normalized per-node so we can spot hotspots.
Priya: relabel applied to 3 canary promtails, monitoring for regressions. ETA 10m.
Alex: thanks team :thumbsup:
